title: Night Cream vs Moisturizer: What Is the Difference?
ex: A night cream is a richer moisturiser made for evening use. Compare texture, actives and timing, and learn when a regular moisturiser is enough at night.
rt: Night Cream vs Moisturizer: The Difference | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream vs moisturizer: a simple comparison table, whether you can use a regular moisturiser at night, and how to choose the right one for your skin.
quick: A night cream is a type of moisturiser made for night, usually richer and often with actives like niacinamide or kojic acid. A regular moisturiser is lighter and sits well under sunscreen. You can use a regular moisturiser at night if your skin feels comfortable by morning.
facts: A night cream is a type of moisturiser
A regular moisturiser without SPF is fine at night
Night creams often contain actives used with morning sunscreen
Dry skin and AC rooms often benefit from a richer night cream
